test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The investment scheme had been a **__scam__** all along.
solution: The correct answer is **"Swindle."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Swindle"** means to cheat or deceive someone in order to get money or something else of value. (ठगी, धोखेबाज़ी) • **Example:** *He was **swindled**__ out of his life savings by a fraudulent investment scheme.* • ** "Scam"** means a clever but dishonest plan for making money. (पैसे कमाने का चतुर परंतु कपटपूर्ण योजना; स्‍कैम) __ • **Example:** *That was a big **scam**__.* • The synonym of **"scam"** is **"swindle."** • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Plain"** means simple or ordinary. (देखने, सुनने, समझने में आसान; स्‍पष्‍ट) • **"Failure"** means a lack of success or inability to achieve a goal. (असफलता, नाकामयाबी) • **"Successful" **means achieving or having achieved success. (सफल, अभीष्‍ट को उपलब्‍ध किए हुए; लोकप्रिय, समृद्घ आदि) 1ad:T57a, The correct answer is **"BADC."**
